101051.title: Fork component arrangement
guidance: Place 1 EA of Fork Crown (Product Number FC-3654) and 1 EA of Steerer (Product Number SR-2098) in an assumed fork assembly jig, with the steerer above the crown.

Arrange 2 EA of Blade (Product Number BL-2036) below the crown and 2 EA of Fork End (Product Number FE-3760) at the lower blade ends. Hold the arrangement in the jig; no permanent joining method is specified.
